verdict.rationale: The evidence shows managed auth for end users: per-user isolation via the x-pd-external-user-id header, a dedicated MCP server per app, credentials kept from AI models, and revocable connected accounts. None of it documents the product letting a user issue scoped or least-privilege API credentials (for example, permission-limited tokens or restricted scopes) for an agent. These are adjacent security controls, not the requested capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
